summary: community.routeros api_modify deprecates writing numbers fields and copy-from/place-before in routing bfd configuration, removed in 4.0.0.
questions: Can I still set numbers with community.routeros api_modify?

answer_card.title: api_modify numbers fields deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `community.routeros.api_modify`, writing any existing **`numbers`** fields is deprecated, as are `copy-from` and `place-before` in `routing bfd configuration`. Support is removed in community.routeros 4.0.0.
